name: Laing Family Trusts
description: The Laing Family Trusts are a group of four grant-making trusts (Beatrice Laing Trust, Kirby Laing Foundation, Maurice & Hilda Laing Charitable Trust and Martin Laing Foundation) sharing a single administration.  The first of the Trusts was established by Sir John Laing in 1952. A builder by trade, Sir John was responsible for moving the family firm from Carlisle to London, where it grew into a global construction company, John Laing plc.  Sir John was a devout Christian and member of the Brethren Movement; his Christian faith was the motivation for the Company’s pioneering concern for the welfare of its staff and the establishment of the first of his grant-making trusts, the J W Laing Trust, which is now administered by the Stewards Company in Bath. Successive generations of the Laing family have built on this example of Christian philanthropy, establishing their own charitable trusts and foundations.  Four of the family’s charitable trusts, the Beatrice Laing Trust, the Kirby Laing Foundation, the Maurice & Hilda Laing Charitable Trust and the Martin Laing Foundation, are administered under the umbrella of the Laing Family Trusts.  Grants are made by the individual trusts, each of which is an independent legal entity with its own separate and autonomous board of trustees. While each follows its own decision-making processes, the Laing Family Trusts’ umbrella provides for economies of scale, with an application to one accepted as an application to all.  The Trusts are members of the Association of Charitable Foundation and The Christian Funders' Forum. The Trusts are a sponsor of the annual Christian Funders' Forum Awards.

The Turnover Trap: Massive revenue, but shrinking margins and rising risk. Most firms stay stuck because they are forcing a “small business” model to handle “big business” demands. At this scale, your firm has two Value Engines: 🟢 The Growth Engine (Marketing & Sales): Predictable acquisition of high-value leads. The Fulfilment Engine (Ops & Delivery): Delivering work without you being on every site. Stagnation happens when these engines fall out of sync. You either stop selling because you’re overwhelmed, or you stop delivering because you're chasing leads. To hit 8-figures, you must synchronise both. The Proof: We have generated over £50M+ revenue for our partners. The Method: We install the infrastructure required to manage 8-figure complexity - ensuring the machine runs profitably without you being the "glue" holding it together. name: Respond
description: Respond is an Approved Housing Body and service provider.  Our vision is that every family and individual in Ireland will have high‐quality housing as part of a vibrant and caring community. Housing and decent accommodation, in the areas where people want to live, are central to improving people’s lives and enhancing the health and well‐being of society. We own and manage over 6,000 properties across the 26 counties in Ireland where approximately 10,000 tenants live. Respond currently have 1,566 homes in construction and onsite.  We provide emergency accommodation with support for families who are homeless in six Family Hubs where our goal is to support families to move into secure homes as quickly as possible leaving homelessness behind. We provide 24/7 wraparound support in relation to access to housing, mental and physical health services, family or parenting support and a range of other issues. We also continue to work with families once they have moved on to ensure the sustainability of these exits. name: Central and North West London NHS Foundation Trust
description: Central and North West London NHS Foundation Trust (CNWL) has almost 9,200 staff providing integrated healthcare to a third of London's population, Milton Keynes, Surrey and areas beyond. We are here to provide support for people through every stage of life.  Our catchment area covers a range of vibrant and diverse communities, with over 100 first languages spoken, ranging from areas of deprivation to areas of affluence. We are committed to providing services that need the needs of the people who use them, and we actively encourage involvement from local people who can help make a difference.

description: Mid Yorkshire Teaching NHS Trust provides acute, community and specialist health care services to around half a million people living in Wakefield and North Kirklees. We have three hospitals at Dewsbury, Pontefract and Wakefield (Pinderfields), and also provide care in community settings such as GP surgeries, health centres and clinics as well as in people’s own homes.   Every one of our 9,000 staff play a vital role in providing quality care to the thousands of people we serve and we are proud to have a hard working, talented, and dynamic work force who strive every day to provide quality care and support to those who use our services.  Our mission is to recruit, develop and retain skilled and motivated people who embody the Trust’s core values of caring, respect, high standards and improving. name: Prestwick Aerosystems
description: Prestwick Aerosystems is a key contributor to the UK’s aerospace sector, playing a vital role in strengthening the nation’s aerostructures manufacturing capability.   Based in Prestwick, Scotland, we specialise in the design and manufacture of high-performance composite aerostructure components, including leading edges, trailing edges, and spoilers for major commercial aircraft programmes such as the Airbus A320, A330 and A350 families, as well as Boeing platforms.  Employing around 1,300 highly skilled people, we are committed to supporting the local and national economy while advancing aerospace expertise. Our operations are underpinned by cutting-edge Resin Transfer Moulding (RTM) technology—an advanced, out-of-autoclave process that enables the efficient, single-step production of complex composite structures.  We work closely with strategic partners including NMIS, education partners and ADS to drive innovation, skills development and long-term growth across the aerospace ecosystem.

We also provide day activities and respite support so that the people we support, their families and carers can enjoy holidays and short breaks.  Our Mission and Purpose Statement  Creative Support promotes independence, inclusion, and wellbeing. We do this by working with the people we support, their families and others to meet individual needs and aspirations in a person-centred way. In addition to this, DCS Manufacturing works with internationally recognised brands and retailers to develop, manufacture and launch Health & Beauty products. The state-of-the-art 100,000-square-foot production facility in Worcestershire is at the centre of our operations.  Denys Shortt also owns the Enable platform which provides retro and rebate management software to a multitude of blue-chip companies worldwide https://enable.com. Denys Shortt, founder and Chairman, is a former England hockey player with an unerring enthusiasm for the Midlands region. He served as the former Chairman of the Coventry & Warwickshire LEP (Local Enterprise Partnership) and has supported many organisations including the Shakespeare Hospice, Stratford-upon-Avon Football Club, and as Chair of the Stratford Hospital Appeal which has raised over £1m. In recognition of his efforts as LEP Chairman, Denys was awarded an OBE in 2013 for Services to the Economy.

Our personalised approach means that we can tailor our services to the specific needs and aspirations of both parties. In short, Marmion combines professionalism with empathy, offering an alternative to the transactional norm. It’s a business where values aren’t just stated—they’re lived daily by a team that takes pride in delivering recruitment solutions that make a real difference.

name: The Johnstown Estate
description: The Johnstown Estate is filled with history, character and warmth, and the listed 18th Century Rural Residence is the beating heart of the Estate. Open fires burn throughout its rooms, with antique finishes including original marble fireplaces, mahogany cabinetry and old volumes of lovingly-thumbed sonnets upon the shelves. Bicycles are available to enjoy the Estate parklands and discover the nearby Royal Canal Greenway   For those with a passion for food, There is a choice of dining experiences, from fine dining at 'Fire & Salt' restaurant to traditional favourites at The Coach House Brasserie, al fresco dining and light bites at the Spa Café.

name: Oliver Bonas
description: Our story starts with our founder, Olly. His creative upbringing, culturally influenced by the many countries he lived in, instilled a love of design and an exploratory spirit from an early age. At university whilst studying Anthropology, Olly began to bring back gifts for friends from his travels abroad. He turned this into a small business and in 1993 the first store opened in London, repainted by his friends with Olly behind a second-hand till. Three decades on, we now have over 85 stores and have evolved from curating others’ designs to creating our own.   At Oliver Bonas (OB), our values of Work Hard, Play Hard & Be Kind are integral to everything we do. Collaboration, imagination, curiosity, and teamwork are key to our success, and everyone has their part to play in making OB a special place to work.     Having fun is key, and a playful and positive approach creates an optimistic environment. We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we are serious about what we do.     Our team knows their stuff. They’re confident and creative and unafraid to challenge convention to find solutions, taking accountability for their actions, but always with kindness and humility.     Our promise is to do our bit to make living a joyful experience and give cause for optimism. This promise is central to our work in equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI). To bring joy to others, we must first ensure everyone at OB feels valued, included and most importantly, can be themselves at work.   At company level, we have set out our approach to EDI with our Leadership team, who are committed to leading on all our initiatives and conveying that message across the business. We empower our managers to promote a sense of belonging within their teams. We also expect everyone at OB to value and look out for each other by always being considerate and mindful of others.    To read more about commitments head over to our EDI page on our website https://www.oliverbonas.com/meet-the-team/diversity

description: JJ Churchill Ltd. is a precision engineering business in the aerospace, powergen, medtech, diesel engine and defence sectors. name: Healix Health

After 25 years of doing things differently, one thing remains unchanged: our commitment to better healthcare for businesses and their people.  This is healthcare, unlocked.

We work globally across sectors where hiring matters most, including industrial and engineering, energy and infrastructure, life sciences, and advanced technology - environments where the cost of getting hiring wrong is high and the need for consistency is critical.
